metadata.description: The xgodev Claude Code marketplace: a single all-in-one plugin bundling every xgodev skill, hook, and tool.

plugins.name: claude-plugin
plugins.description: All-in-one xgodev plugin: the boost skill set (github.com/xgodev/boost), the Quality Gate (dispatcher + per-language gates + the quality-gate skill + opt-in pre-push hook), the dev-rules engineering-discipline skill with RED-first enforcement hooks, and the skill-rules skill-authoring discipline.

plugins.name: ux-ui-mastery
plugins.description: UX/UI design mastery plugin by Design Tribe Republic (fork of phazurlabs/ux-ui-mastery with a manifest fix so Claude Code can install it). Auto-installs as a dependency of claude-plugin.
